parameters.content:
## Mills | Lead magnets: all 11 services (Zoho CRM)
**Webhook:** POST, form-urlencoded (what the site sends). The Respond nodes return JSON so the site sees a 200.
**Setup:**
1. Pick your Zoho CRM (OAuth2, your data center) and Gmail credentials on the three action nodes.
2. **Segmentation.** In Zoho create custom Lead fields: Service (picklist with the 11 values: Mills Entry, Mills Permits, Mills Customs, Mills Projects, Mills Marine, Mills Dangerous Goods, Mills Logistics, Mills Packaging, Mills Insurance, Mills Time Critical, Mills Advisory) and Priority (picklist: Hot, Normal). Then make one Custom View per service filtered on Service.
3. Set each service owner's email in the OWNERS list in the code node; the team notification goes to that person.
4. Activate, then copy the **Production URL** into js/lead-magnet.js (WEBHOOK_URL).
**Test:** use the Test URL once, then switch to Production.
